<h2>Mathematics Tutoring & Resources</h2>
<p style="text-align: left;">
I aim to provide high-quality worksheets, summaries, and learning resources covering all levels of mathematics. 
</p>

<h3 style="text-align: left;">My Workflow & Quality Control</h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">
To streamline resource creation, I utilise AI (primarily Google Gemini) to assist in drafting questions and solutions. However, every single worksheet undergoes human review to catch and correct errors. These materials are typeset using LaTeX, ensuring clean, professional mathematical formatting. 
</p>

<p style="text-align: left;">
While I strive for absolute accuracy, human error can happen—any mistakes are ultimately my own! If you spot an error, have a question, or need tailored resources, please <a href="mailto:forbessam2@gmail.com" style="color: #0066cc;">get in touch</a>!
</p>
